grammar: n. 苔藓，通常作不可数名词；表示不同种类时可用 mosses。
collocations: green moss; moss grows on rocks; a layer of moss
commonMistake: 泛指苔藓时通常不加 a，也不使用复数；可说 a patch of moss。

example.english: Soft moss grows on the wet stones.
example.chinese: 湿润的石头上长着柔软的苔藓。

application.prompt: After the rain, a green plant-like cover appeared on the stones. It was ___. A. moss B. pepper
application.solution: A。解析：moss 指石头或地面上常见的苔藓。

grammar: n. 红杉；红木。作可数名词时复数为 redwoods；redwood 也可作定语修饰 tree。
collocations: a redwood tree; a redwood forest; tall redwoods
commonMistake: redwood 指树种或红木，不要与表示“红色木头”的普通组合 red wood 混淆。

example.english: The redwood trees in the park are very tall.
example.chinese: 公园里的红杉树非常高。

application.prompt: Some of the world's tallest trees are ___. A. mushrooms B. redwoods
application.solution: B。解析：redwood 是红杉树。

examTags: 阅读·根据特征识别动物
grammar: n. 猎豹；可数名词，复数 cheetahs。
collocations: a fast cheetah; a cheetah in the grassland; cheetahs run quickly
commonMistake: cheetah 是猎豹，不是 leopard（花豹）；猎豹以奔跑速度快著称。

example.english: A cheetah can run very fast for a short time.
example.chinese: 猎豹能在短时间内跑得很快。

application.prompt: Which animal is known for running at great speed? A. frog B. cheetah
application.solution: B。解析：cheetah（猎豹）以短距离高速奔跑闻名。

examTags: 语法·现在分词作形容词
grammar: adj. 折叠式的；可折叠的。由 fold 加 -ing 构成，常放在名词前作定语。
collocations: a folding chair; a folding table; a folding screen
commonMistake: folding 作形容词表示“可折叠的”；不要误解为动作正在进行。

example.english: We took a folding chair on the camping trip.
example.chinese: 我们带了一把折叠椅去露营。

application.prompt: The small chair can be folded and carried easily. It is a ___ chair. A. boiling B. folding
application.solution: B。解析：能折叠的椅子可称为 a folding chair。

grammar: n. 折扇；可数名词，复数 folding fans。folding 作定语修饰 fan。
collocations: open a folding fan; a paper folding fan; paint a folding fan
commonMistake: 复数只需在中心名词 fan 后加 -s：folding fans。

example.english: She opened a folding fan to cool herself.
example.chinese: 她打开一把折扇给自己扇风。

application.prompt: You can open and close this traditional fan by folding it. It is a ___. A. frying pan B. folding fan
application.solution: B。解析：可以折叠开合的扇子是 folding fan。

grammar: n. 竹；竹子。通常作不可数名词；指一根竹子时可说 a bamboo plant。
collocations: bamboo forest; bamboo shoots; a bamboo chair
commonMistake: bamboo 泛指竹材或竹子时通常不加 -s；“竹笋”常说 bamboo shoots。

example.english: The pandas ate bamboo in the forest.
example.chinese: 熊猫在竹林里吃竹子。

application.prompt: Many pandas feed on ___. A. bamboo B. flour
application.solution: A。解析：熊猫主要以竹子为食，bamboo 指竹子。

grammar: interj. 是的；对。较口语化，正式写作或较正式回答中通常用 yes。
collocations: Yeah, sure.; Yeah, I know.; say yeah
commonMistake: yeah 适合熟人间的口语对话；正式场合宜用 yes，且句首要大写。

example.english: “Are you ready?” “Yeah, let's go.”
example.chinese: “你准备好了吗？”“嗯，走吧。”

application.prompt: In a formal interview, which answer is more suitable? A. Yes, I am. B. Yeah, I am.
application.solution: A。解析：正式场合一般用 yes；yeah 更口语化。

grammar: adj. 受欢迎的；流行的。常用 be popular with/among sb；表示流行于某地可用 popular in。
collocations: popular with students; popular among young people; a popular song
commonMistake: 表示“受某人欢迎”用 popular with/among，不说 popular to sb。

example.english: The nature club is popular with students at our school.
example.chinese: 自然社团在我们学校很受学生欢迎。

application.prompt: The new game is liked by many children. It is ___ with them. A. empty B. popular
application.solution: B。解析：be popular with sb 表示“受某人欢迎”。

grammar: n. 美德；善良；（食物的）营养成分。通常不可数；Goodness! 也可作感叹语。
collocations: the goodness of fresh food; goodness and kindness; Goodness me!
commonMistake: goodness 是 good 的名词形式；表示“好处、营养”时通常不说 a goodness。

example.english: Fresh vegetables keep much of their natural goodness.
example.chinese: 新鲜蔬菜保留了许多天然营养。

application.prompt: Fresh fruit is good for you and has natural ___. A. title B. goodness
application.solution: B。解析：goodness 可指食物中有益的营养成分。

grammar: n. 工具；手段。可数名词，复数 tools；也可引申为完成某事的手段。
collocations: a useful tool; gardening tools; a tool for learning
commonMistake: tool 作“工具”时是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a、the 或其他限定词。

example.english: A map is a useful tool for planning a walk.
example.chinese: 地图是规划散步路线的有用工具。

application.prompt: A spade is a garden ___. A. tool B. planet
application.solution: A。解析：spade（铁锹）属于 tool（工具）。

grammar: adv. 实际上；事实上；居然。常用于补充真实情况或委婉纠正，位置较灵活。
collocations: actually know; actually be; but actually
commonMistake: actually 表示“事实上”，不等于 currently（目前）；不要按中文“实际地”生硬翻译。

example.english: I thought the plant was small, but it is actually quite tall.
example.chinese: 我原以为这株植物很小，但它实际上相当高。

application.prompt: I expected the walk to be short, but it took two hours ___. A. actually B. loudly
application.solution: A。解析：actually 用来说明实际情况与原先想法不同。

grammar: n. 幼苗；嫩芽；v. 射击；发射。表示“射击”时过去式和过去分词为 shot；作植物“长出嫩芽”时也可用 shoot。
collocations: a new shoot; bamboo shoots; shoot a ball
commonMistake: 表示“射击”的过去式是 shot，不是 shooted；本单元名词义可指植物嫩芽。

example.english: New green shoots appeared after the warm rain.
example.chinese: 一场暖雨后，新的绿芽长了出来。

application.prompt: Small new parts growing from a plant are called ___. A. shoots B. wings
application.solution: A。解析：shoot 作名词可指植物的嫩芽。

examTags: 语法·系动词与不及物动词
grammar: v. 出现；显得、看起来好像。可用 appear in/on 表示出现于某处，也可用 appear + adj./to be 表示“似乎”。
collocations: appear on the page; appear suddenly; appear to be healthy
commonMistake: appear 表示“出现”时通常不直接接宾语；表示“看起来”可接形容词或 to be。

example.english: A small frog appeared beside the pond.
example.chinese: 一只小青蛙出现在池塘旁边。

application.prompt: A rainbow ___ in the sky after the rain. A. appeared B. protected
application.solution: A。解析：彩虹“出现”用 appear；过去发生用 appeared。

grammar: phr. 请随意（做某事）；尽管（做某事）。常用 feel free to do sth，表示友好地允许或邀请。
collocations: feel free to ask; feel free to call; feel free to look around
commonMistake: to 后接动词原形：feel free to ask；不要接动名词 asking。

example.english: Feel free to ask me about the plants in the garden.
example.chinese: 关于花园里的植物，尽管问我。

application.prompt: You may ask any question you like. Please feel free ___ me. A. asking B. to ask
application.solution: B。解析：feel free 后接 to do，故用 to ask。

grammar: n. 陆地；土地；v. 降落、着陆。land on/in 表示降落在某处；作名词时常与 sea 对照。
collocations: on land; farmland; land safely; land on the ground
commonMistake: land 作名词表示陆地或土地；作动词表示着陆，过去式和过去分词均为 landed。

example.english: The butterfly landed on a flower near the path.
example.chinese: 蝴蝶落在小路旁的一朵花上。

application.prompt: The bird flew down and ___ on a branch. A. landed B. connected
application.solution: A。解析：飞鸟“着陆、落在”树枝上用 land on。

examTags: 拼写·国籍与地区形容词
grammar: adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；n. 非洲人。由 Africa 派生，首字母始终大写。
collocations: African countries; African wildlife; an African writer
commonMistake: Africa 是洲名，African 是其形容词或表示非洲人的名词；两者首字母均大写。

example.english: The book describes animals in an African grassland.
example.chinese: 这本书描写了非洲草原上的动物。

application.prompt: The adjective formed from Africa is ___. A. Africa B. African
application.solution: B。解析：表示“非洲的”用形容词 African。

grammar: n. 玫瑰；蔷薇；rose 也可作 rise 的过去式，须根据句子中的位置和语境区分。
collocations: a red rose; a rose garden; a bunch of roses
commonMistake: rose 作花名时是可数名词，复数 roses；作 rise 的过去式时是动词，不加 -s。

example.english: A red rose grew beside the garden gate.
example.chinese: 花园门边长着一朵红玫瑰。

application.prompt: She gave her mother a beautiful ___. A. frog B. rose
application.solution: B。解析：送给妈妈的花可以是一朵 rose（玫瑰）。

grammar: n. 牡丹；芍药。可数名词，复数 peonies（辅音字母加 y 变 y 为 i 再加 -es）。
collocations: a peony flower; peony blossoms; a garden of peonies
commonMistake: peony 的复数是 peonies，不是 peonys；注意 y 变 i 再加 -es。

example.english: The peonies bloom in the garden in spring.
example.chinese: 牡丹在春天于花园里开放。

application.prompt: Several ___ are blooming near the wall. A. peonys B. peonies
application.solution: B。解析：以辅音字母加 y 结尾的 peony 变复数为 peonies。

grammar: n. 莲花；荷花。可数名词，复数可写 lotuses 或 loti；初中阶段常用 lotuses。
collocations: a lotus flower; lotus leaves; a lotus pond
commonMistake: lotus 的常见复数是 lotuses；不要把它与 lotus root（莲藕）混为一谈。

example.english: A pink lotus opened in the pond.
example.chinese: 池塘里一朵粉色的莲花开了。

application.prompt: The flower that grows on a pond is a ___. A. province B. lotus
application.solution: B。解析：lotus 指莲花或荷花。

grammar: n. 蝴蝶；可数名词，复数 butterflies（辅音字母加 y 变 y 为 i 再加 -es）。
collocations: a colorful butterfly; butterfly wings; butterflies in the garden
commonMistake: butterfly 的复数是 butterflies，不是 butterflys；注意 y 变 i。

example.english: A butterfly rested on the yellow flower.
example.chinese: 一只蝴蝶停在黄色的花上。

application.prompt: Two ___ flew over the flowers. A. butterflies B. butterflys
application.solution: A。解析：butterfly 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数为 butterflies。

grammar: n. 翅膀；翼；可数名词，复数 wings；也可指建筑物的侧翼。
collocations: a bird's wing; spread its wings; butterfly wings
commonMistake: wing 是可数名词；表示一只鸟的两只翅膀时通常用复数 wings。

example.english: The bird hurt one wing but soon recovered.
example.chinese: 这只鸟伤了一只翅膀，但很快恢复了。

application.prompt: A bird uses its ___ to fly. A. wings B. roots
application.solution: A。解析：鸟用翅膀飞行，wing 的复数是 wings。

grammar: n. 蛙；青蛙。可数名词，复数 frogs；可用 a frog / frogs 表示单复数。
collocations: a green frog; a frog in the pond; frogs jump
commonMistake: frog 的复数直接加 -s：frogs；不要写成 frogges。

example.english: A frog jumped into the pond.
example.chinese: 一只青蛙跳进了池塘。

application.prompt: This small animal can jump and often lives near water. It is a ___. A. frog B. mushroom
application.solution: A。解析：能跳、常生活在水边的小动物是 frog。

grammar: phr. 多达；至多；直到；还可表示由某人负责。具体意思需结合后接数字、时间或动作判断。
collocations: up to ten people; up to now; be up to you
commonMistake: up to + 数字表示“多达/至多”；up to now 表示“到目前为止”，不要一概译成“直到”。

example.english: The garden can hold up to thirty visitors.
example.chinese: 这个花园最多可容纳三十名游客。

application.prompt: The bus can carry ___ 40 passengers. A. up to B. without
application.solution: A。解析：up to + 数字表示“多达、至多”。

grammar: v. 有……重；称重量。表示重量时常用 weigh + 数字 + 单位；weigh something 表示称某物重量。
collocations: weigh 20 kilograms; weigh a bag; weigh more than
commonMistake: 询问重量常用 How much does it weigh?；不要把动词 weigh 与名词 weight 混用。

example.english: The young panda weighs about ten kilograms.
example.chinese: 这只熊猫幼崽重约十千克。

application.prompt: How much does the box ___? A. weight B. weigh
application.solution: B。解析：助动词 does 后接动词原形 weigh；weight 是名词。

grammar: 缩写，kilogram 的符号，表示千克（公斤）。数字后直接写 kg，符号不加复数 -s，也不加句点。
collocations: 5 kg of rice; weigh 20 kg; a 2 kg bag
commonMistake: kg 是国际单位符号，大小写固定为小写 kg；数字后不写 kgs。

example.english: The sack of rice weighs 10 kg.
example.chinese: 这袋米重 10 千克。

application.prompt: Which is the standard symbol for kilogram? A. KG. B. kg
application.solution: B。解析：千克符号写作 kg，小写且不加句点。

grammar: n. 银杏；可数名词，复数常写 ginkgoes，也可写 ginkgos。
collocations: a ginkgo tree; ginkgo leaves; a row of ginkgoes
commonMistake: ginkgo 的拼写中有 k；不要误写为 gingko。

example.english: The ginkgo leaves turn yellow in autumn.
example.chinese: 银杏叶在秋天变黄。

application.prompt: The tree with fan-shaped leaves is a ___. A. cheetah B. ginkgo
application.solution: B。解析：扇形叶片是银杏树的典型特征之一。

grammar: v. 相信；认为。可接名词、that 从句或 sb/sth to be...；believe in 表示信任或相信其价值。
collocations: believe a story; believe that it is true; believe in yourself
commonMistake: believe 表示相信某个说法；believe in 常表示信任某人或相信某事物的价值。

example.english: I believe that every plant has a role in nature.
example.chinese: 我认为每种植物在自然界都有作用。

application.prompt: Many people ___ that trees help clean the air. A. believe B. weigh
application.solution: A。解析：believe that... 表示“认为……”。

grammar: n. 省份；可数名词，复数 provinces。专有地名中的省名首字母大写。
collocations: a coastal province; in the province; provincial capital
commonMistake: province 是普通名词，只有具体省名中的 Province 才按专名大写；注意复数 provinces。

example.english: This province is famous for its forests and rivers.
example.chinese: 这个省以森林和河流闻名。

application.prompt: A country may be divided into smaller areas called ___. A. provinces B. planets
application.solution: A。解析：province 指省份。

grammar: phr. 散步。常用 take a walk；walk 也可作动词，如 walk around the park。
collocations: take a walk after dinner; take a long walk; take a walk in the park
commonMistake: 固定表达中用 take a walk；若直接用动词则说 walk，不说 take walk。

example.english: We take a walk by the river after dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭后我们沿河散步。

application.prompt: After sitting all day, Mia went outside to ___. A. take a walk B. boil water
application.solution: A。解析：外出散步可说 take a walk。

grammar: v. 连接；使有联系。常用 connect A to/with B；connect with 也可表示与某人沟通或产生共鸣。
collocations: connect a computer to the internet; connect two places; connect with people
commonMistake: 表达“把 A 和 B 连接起来”用 connect A to/with B；不要漏掉连接对象前的介词。

example.english: A path connects the village with the nature park.
example.chinese: 一条小路把村庄和自然公园连接起来。

application.prompt: This bridge ___ the two sides of the river. A. imagines B. connects
application.solution: B。解析：连接两地用 connect；主语为单数，动词加 -s。

examTags: 语法·形容词与过去分词
grammar: adj. 连接的；相关的。可用 be connected to/with；由 connect 加 -ed 构成。
collocations: be connected to a network; closely connected with; a connected system
commonMistake: 表示“与……有关/相连”用 be connected with/to；connected 后需保留介词。

example.english: These ideas are connected with the health of the ecosystem.
example.chinese: 这些观点与生态系统的健康有关。

application.prompt: The two ponds are linked by a stream. They are ___ by water. A. disappointed B. connected
application.solution: B。解析：connected 表示“连接在一起的”。

grammar: phr. 与……相连；与……有关。be connected with/to + 名词或代词；主语与 connect 构成被动关系。
collocations: be connected with nature; be connected to the road; be closely connected with health
commonMistake: 搭配中的介词 with/to 不能省略；主语是复数时用 are connected。

example.english: The health of bees is connected with the health of plants.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂的健康与植物的健康有关。

application.prompt: Air pollution is ___ people's health. A. connected with B. connected at
application.solution: A。解析：表示“与……有关”用 be connected with。

examTags: 语法·介词后接名词或动名词
grammar: prep. 没有；缺乏；不做。后接名词、代词或动名词，不能直接接动词原形。
collocations: without water; without help; leave without saying goodbye
commonMistake: without 是介词，后接 doing：without asking；不要说 without ask。

example.english: Many plants cannot live without enough water.
example.chinese: 许多植物没有足够的水就无法生存。

application.prompt: He left the room ___ saying goodbye. A. during B. without
application.solution: B。解析：without 后可接动名词 saying，表示“没有道别就……”。

examTags: 语法·动名词与宾语从句
grammar: v. 想象；猜想。常用 imagine doing sth、imagine + 名词或 imagine (that) 从句。
collocations: imagine a future; imagine living in the forest; imagine that it is possible
commonMistake: imagine 后表示“想象做某事”用动名词：imagine doing，不用 imagine to do。

example.english: Can you imagine living without plants or animals?
example.chinese: 你能想象生活中没有植物或动物吗？

application.prompt: She can ___ walking through a forest full of flowers. A. imagine B. protect
application.solution: A。解析：imagine 后接动名词 walking。

examTags: 语法·不可数名词与称呼语
grammar: n. 蜂蜜，通常不可数；也可作亲昵称呼语 honey。
collocations: a spoonful of honey; honey bees; honey and lemon
commonMistake: 表示蜂蜜时通常不说 a honey；可说 some honey 或 a spoonful of honey。

example.english: Bees make honey from flower nectar.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂用花蜜酿造蜂蜜。

application.prompt: Add a little ___ to the tea if you like it sweet. A. honey B. butterfly
application.solution: A。解析：蜂蜜可用来给茶调味，honey 通常不可数。

grammar: adj. 失望的；沮丧的。表示对结果失望用 disappointed with/about；对某人失望可用 disappointed in。
collocations: feel disappointed; be disappointed with the result; disappointed in someone
commonMistake: disappointed 描述感到失望的人；令人失望的事物用 disappointing。

example.english: We were disappointed with the low number of visitors.
example.chinese: 游客人数很少，我们对此感到失望。

application.prompt: The test result made Leo feel ___. A. disappointing B. disappointed
application.solution: B。解析：Leo 是感到失望的人，用 disappointed；令人失望的事物用 disappointing。

grammar: n. 联系；连接。可数名词，复数 connections；常用 connection between A and B 或 connection with。
collocations: a connection between bees and flowers; internet connection; have a connection with
commonMistake: 表示 A 与 B 之间的联系用 a connection between A and B；不要遗漏 between 后的 and。

example.english: There is a close connection between bees and many plants.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂和许多植物之间有密切联系。

application.prompt: Scientists found a strong ___ between clean water and healthy plants. A. connection B. action
application.solution: A。解析：connection 表示“联系”，常用 connection between。

grammar: n. 授粉。通常不可数；由 pollinate（给……授粉）加名词后缀构成。
collocations: plant pollination; pollination by bees; help with pollination
commonMistake: pollination 是“授粉”这一过程；实施授粉用动词 pollinate，传粉者可称 pollinator。

example.english: Bees help with the pollination of many flowers.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂帮助许多花朵授粉。

application.prompt: The transfer of pollen that helps plants produce seeds is called ___. A. communication B. pollination
application.solution: B。解析：pollination 指花粉传播并完成授粉的过程。

grammar: n. 花粉；通常作不可数名词，指植物产生的细小粉末。
collocations: pollen from flowers; carry pollen; pollen grains
commonMistake: 泛指花粉时 pollen 通常不可数；不能按普通可数名词直接说 a pollen。

example.english: The bee carried pollen from one flower to another.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花。

application.prompt: Bees carry ___ between flowers. A. climates B. pollen
application.solution: B。解析：花朵之间由蜜蜂携带的是 pollen（花粉）。

grammar: n. 行动；行为。可数名词，常用 take action 表示“采取行动”，action 也可指动作或举措。
collocations: take action; a plan of action; an action to protect wildlife
commonMistake: 固定搭配通常说 take action，不说 make an action；具体一项举措可说 an action。

example.english: We must take action to protect the local river.
example.chinese: 我们必须采取行动保护当地河流。

application.prompt: The river is polluted, so the town must take ___ soon. A. action B. happiness
application.solution: A。解析：take action 是“采取行动”的固定搭配。

grammar: phr. 事实上；实际上。常用于补充、强调或纠正前文信息，常置于句首或句中。
collocations: in fact, ...; not easy—in fact, difficult; know the facts
commonMistake: in fact 是副词性短语，通常不接 of；表示“事实上”不要误写为 in the fact。

example.english: Some insects look small. In fact, they are important to the ecosystem.
example.chinese: 有些昆虫看起来很小。事实上，它们对生态系统很重要。

application.prompt: I thought the island was empty. ___, many animals live there. A. For example of B. In fact
application.solution: B。解析：in fact 用来补充真实情况。

examTags: 语法·百分比与主谓一致
grammar: n./adj./adv. 百分之……；每一百中。数字 + per cent 表示百分数；作主语时谓语常按 of 后名词的单复数确定。
collocations: 50 per cent of the land; ten per cent; per cent of people
commonMistake: per cent 与 percent 意义相同；表示“百分之五十”说 50 per cent，谓语依 of 后名词判断。

example.english: About 30 per cent of the land is covered by forest.
example.chinese: 大约百分之三十的土地被森林覆盖。

application.prompt: Forty ___ of the students joined the nature club. A. per cent B. kilograms
application.solution: A。解析：表示百分比用 per cent；数字 forty 放在其前。

grammar: phr. 出于这个原因；因此。常置于句首，后接逗号和结果分句。
collocations: for this reason, ...; for this reason alone; explain the reason
commonMistake: for this reason 后接结果；说明原因可用 because，避免同一句中重复 because...so。

example.english: Bees help many plants reproduce. For this reason, we should protect them.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂帮助许多植物繁殖。出于这个原因，我们应该保护它们。

application.prompt: The pond is home to many frogs. ___, the town keeps it clean. A. For this reason B. At least
application.solution: A。解析：前句给出原因，后句说明因此采取的行动。

grammar: n. 行星；可数名词，复数 planets。the planet 常指地球或人类赖以生存的地球。
collocations: the planet Earth; another planet; protect our planet
commonMistake: planet 是行星；不要与表示“计划”的 plan 混淆拼写。

example.english: We should keep our planet clean and healthy.
example.chinese: 我们应该让自己的星球保持清洁、健康。

application.prompt: Earth is the ___ on which we live. A. planet B. province
application.solution: A。解析：地球是一颗行星，planet 指行星。

examTags: 语法·不定式作目的状语
grammar: phr. 为了；以便。后接动词原形，表示目的；否定形式为 in order not to do sth。
collocations: in order to protect nature; in order to learn; in order not to waste water
commonMistake: in order to 后接动词原形；不定式表目的时可简化为 to，但不要接动名词。

example.english: We planted flowers in order to attract more bees.
example.chinese: 我们种花是为了吸引更多蜜蜂。

application.prompt: The school built a garden ___ give students a place to study nature. A. because of B. in order to
application.solution: B。解析：后面接动词原形 give，表示建花园的目的。

grammar: v. 贮存；存储；n. 商店。store sth in/on... 表示把东西存放在某处；需结合宾语判断词性。
collocations: store food for winter; store information; a grocery store
commonMistake: store 作动词是“贮存/储存”，作名词是“商店”；不要只按“商店”一个词义理解。

example.english: Squirrels store nuts for the winter.
example.chinese: 松鼠为冬天贮存坚果。

application.prompt: Some animals ___ food before the cold season. A. store B. title
application.solution: A。解析：在冬季来临前动物会储存食物，store 作动词。

grammar: n. 蜂巢；蜂窝。可数名词，复数 honeycombs；常指蜜蜂用蜡建成的六边形巢房结构。
collocations: a honeycomb structure; a piece of honeycomb; cells in a honeycomb
commonMistake: honeycomb 指蜂巢结构；蜂蜜是 honey，二者含义不同。

example.english: The bees built a honeycomb inside the wooden box.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂在木箱里筑了一个蜂巢。

application.prompt: Bees make a structure with many small wax cells called a ___. A. honeycomb B. mushroom
application.solution: A。解析：蜜蜂用蜡筑成的蜂窝结构叫 honeycomb。

grammar: v. 交流；沟通；传达。常用 communicate with sb、communicate sth to sb；communication 是名词。
collocations: communicate with each other; communicate an idea; communicate by email
commonMistake: 表示“与某人交流”用 communicate with sb；表示把信息传达给某人可用 communicate sth to sb。

example.english: Bees communicate with one another through movement.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂通过动作彼此交流。

application.prompt: The students used a map to ___ their ideas to the group. A. communicate B. boil
application.solution: A。解析：把想法传达给小组可用 communicate ideas to the group。

grammar: phr. 参与；在……中起作用。常用 play a part in sth/doing sth；主语为第三人称单数时 play 变 plays。
collocations: play a part in nature; play an important part in; play a part in protecting wildlife
commonMistake: 固定搭配是 play a part in；in 后接名词或动名词，不说 play part on。

example.english: Every insect plays a part in the ecosystem.
example.chinese: 每一种昆虫都在生态系统中发挥作用。

application.prompt: Trees ___ an important part in keeping the air clean. A. play B. do
application.solution: A。解析：固定搭配为 play a part in，主语 trees 为复数。

grammar: n. 生态系统；可数名词，复数 ecosystems。指生物及其环境相互作用形成的系统。
collocations: a forest ecosystem; a healthy ecosystem; protect the ecosystem
commonMistake: ecosystem 是可数名词，单数前要有限定词，如 an ecosystem；拼写中 system 以 y 开头。

example.english: A pond is a small ecosystem full of life.
example.chinese: 池塘是一个充满生命的小型生态系统。

application.prompt: Plants, animals, and their environment together form an ___. A. instruction B. ecosystem
application.solution: B。解析：生物与环境相互作用形成 ecosystem。

grammar: v. 保护；防护。常用 protect sb/sth from/against sth；protection 为名词，protective 为形容词。
collocations: protect wild animals; protect forests from fire; protect the environment
commonMistake: 表示保护某人免受某物伤害用 protect sb from/against sth；protect 后不直接接 against 作被保护对象。

example.english: We can protect bees by planting more flowers.
example.chinese: 我们可以通过种更多的花来保护蜜蜂。

application.prompt: People should ___ rivers from pollution. A. disappoint B. protect
application.solution: B。解析：保护河流免受污染用 protect rivers from pollution。

examTags: 语法·不可数名词与介词
grammar: n. 重要性；通常不可数。常用 the importance of sth/doing sth；由 important 加 -ance 构成。
collocations: the importance of sleep; understand the importance of; of great importance
commonMistake: 表示“……的重要性”用 the importance of；不要与形容词 important 混用。

example.english: The lesson explains the importance of clean water.
example.chinese: 这节课说明了清洁饮水的重要性。

application.prompt: We learned about the ___ of protecting local wildlife. A. importance B. important
application.solution: A。解析：the 后接名词 importance；important 是形容词。

grammar: n. 标题；题目；名称；可数名词，复数 titles。标题中的实词通常按标题格式大写，具体依写作规范。
collocations: the title of a book; give an article a title; a suitable title
commonMistake: 询问文章标题可说 What is the title?；不要与表示“风格”的 style 混淆。

example.english: The title of her report is “Life in a Pond.”
example.chinese: 她的报告题目是《池塘里的生活》。

application.prompt: Choose a suitable ___ for your article before you hand it in. A. title B. spoon
application.solution: A。解析：文章或报告的题目是 title。

grammar: n. 人；人类；adj. 人的；人类的。复数作“人”时为 humans；作形容词时修饰名词。
collocations: human beings; human life; human activity
commonMistake: human 作名词时复数为 humans，也可说 human beings；作形容词时修饰名词，如 human life。

example.english: Human activity can change the natural environment.
example.chinese: 人类活动会改变自然环境。

application.prompt: People are also called ___ beings. A. human B. lively
application.solution: A。解析：human beings 表示“人类”。

grammar: n. 蚂蚁；可数名词，复数 ants；单数前用 an，因为发音以元音音素开头。
collocations: an anthill; a line of ants; ants carry food
commonMistake: ant 前用 an：an ant；复数直接加 -s：ants。

example.english: An ant carried a crumb across the path.
example.chinese: 一只蚂蚁把面包屑搬过小路。

application.prompt: ___ ant can carry food many times its own weight. A. A B. An
application.solution: B。解析：ant 发音以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。

grammar: phr. 是……的栖息地；是……的家乡。home 在此作名词，to 后接居住者或事物。
collocations: be home to many birds; be home to rare plants; a forest home to wildlife
commonMistake: 固定结构为 be home to；不要说 be home of。主语为单数时用 is home to。

example.english: The wetland is home to many kinds of birds.
example.chinese: 这片湿地是许多种鸟类的栖息地。

application.prompt: This forest ___ hundreds of animal species. A. is home to B. is popular with
application.solution: A。解析：说明某地是动物栖息地用 be home to。

grammar: n. 幸福；快乐；通常不可数。由 happy 变 y 为 i 再加 -ness 构成。
collocations: a feeling of happiness; bring happiness to; health and happiness
commonMistake: happiness 是不可数名词，通常不加 a；拼写由 happy 变 y 为 i 后加 -ness。

example.english: Spending time with family brings her happiness.
example.chinese: 和家人共度时光给她带来快乐。

application.prompt: Helping others can bring ___ to both people. A. happy B. happiness
application.solution: B。解析：bring 后接名词 happiness；happy 是形容词。

grammar: v. 使失望；使破灭。disappoint—disappointed—disappointed；形容人的感受用 disappointed，事物令人失望用 disappointing。
collocations: disappoint a friend; disappoint the team; be disappointed by the result
commonMistake: disappoint 是“使某人失望”；描述人的感受用 disappointed，描述令人失望的事物用 disappointing。

example.english: I did not want to disappoint my teammates.
example.chinese: 我不想让队友失望。

application.prompt: The team worked hard and did not want to ___ its coach. A. connect B. disappoint
application.solution: B。解析：disappoint sb 表示“使某人失望”。

grammar: n. 蘑菇；伞菌。可数名词，复数 mushrooms；有些蘑菇可食用，有些不可食用。
collocations: wild mushrooms; mushroom soup; pick mushrooms
commonMistake: mushroom 是可数名词，表示一朵时用 a mushroom；不可随意采食野生蘑菇。

example.english: Small mushrooms grew under the old tree.
example.chinese: 老树下长出了小蘑菇。

application.prompt: A ___ is a kind of fungus often used in cooking. A. planet B. mushroom
application.solution: B。解析：蘑菇是一类常用于烹饪的真菌。

grammar: n. 吨；可数名词，复数 tons。英制 ton 与公制 tonne 的具体重量不同，阅读时应看语境和单位标注。
collocations: a ton of sand; two tons of waste; weigh several tons
commonMistake: ton 是质量单位“吨”，可数；a ton of 后接名词，谓语通常随整体数量表达处理。

example.english: The truck carried two tons of soil.
example.chinese: 卡车运了两吨土。

application.prompt: The large truck can carry several ___ of stone. A. tons B. ton's
application.solution: A。解析：ton 的复数直接加 -s，表示若干吨。

grammar: n. 作用；职能；角色。可数名词，常用 the role of... 或 play a role in...。
collocations: the role of bees; play an important role in; the role of a teacher
commonMistake: 表示“在……中起作用”用 play a role in；role 前通常有冠词或形容词修饰。

example.english: Bees play an important role in pollination.
example.chinese: 蜜蜂在授粉中发挥重要作用。

application.prompt: Trees have an important ___ in providing homes for birds. A. sour B. role
application.solution: B。解析：have a role in 表示“在……中有作用”。

examTags: 语法·动名词作介词宾语
grammar: phr. 在……中发挥作用；扮演角色。play a role in 后接名词或动名词；表示重要作用可加 important。
collocations: play a role in nature; play a role in keeping balance; play an important role
commonMistake: in 是介词，后接名词或 doing：play a role in protecting；不要接动词原形。

example.english: Small insects play a role in keeping the ecosystem balanced.
example.chinese: 小昆虫在维持生态系统平衡方面发挥作用。

application.prompt: Plants play a role in ___ oxygen. A. produce B. producing
application.solution: B。解析：in 是介词，后接动名词 producing。

grammar: n. 豌豆；可数名词，单数 pea，复数 peas；豌豆荚为 pea pod。
collocations: green peas; a pea pod; a bowl of peas
commonMistake: pea 指一粒豌豆，peas 指多粒豌豆；不要与 pea 的复数误写为 peases。

example.english: She added a handful of peas to the soup.
example.chinese: 她往汤里加了一把豌豆。

application.prompt: A small round green vegetable is a ___. A. wing B. pea
application.solution: B。解析：pea 指豌豆。

grammar: n. 气候；可数名词，复数 climates。常说 the climate of/in a place；指长期天气特征。
collocations: a warm climate; climate change; the climate in the north
commonMistake: climate 指一个地区长期的气候；某一天的天气用 weather，不可互换。

example.english: The warm climate allows these plants to grow all year.
example.chinese: 温暖的气候让这些植物全年都能生长。

application.prompt: The long-term weather conditions of a region are its ___. A. action B. climate
application.solution: B。解析：长期天气特征是 climate（气候）。

grammar: n. 大海；海洋。可数名词，复数 oceans；具体海洋名称前常用 the，如 the Pacific Ocean。
collocations: across the ocean; ocean life; the Pacific Ocean
commonMistake: 普通名词 ocean 前通常用 an/the；具体海洋名称首字母大写并加 the。

example.english: Many kinds of sea life live in the ocean.
example.chinese: 许多种海洋生物生活在海洋里。

application.prompt: The Pacific ___ is the largest ocean on Earth. A. ocean's B. Ocean
application.solution: B。解析：海洋专名写作 the Pacific Ocean，专名部分大写。

grammar: prep. 除……之外；不包括。常用于整体中排除一个或一些对象；except for 可用于对整体作补充说明。
collocations: everyone except me; open every day except Sunday; except for one problem
commonMistake: except 表示“除外、不包括”；besides 表示“除此之外还包括”，二者含义相反。

example.english: All the flowers except one are open.
example.chinese: 除一朵外，所有花都开了。

application.prompt: The garden is open every day ___ Monday. A. except B. besides
application.solution: A。解析：不包括星期一用 except；besides 表示“除……之外还”。

grammar: adj. 极小的；微小的。比较级 tinier，最高级 tiniest；可作定语或表语。
collocations: a tiny insect; a tiny amount; tiny seeds
commonMistake: tiny 表示“极小的”；比较级和最高级要变 y 为 i：tinier、tiniest。

example.english: A tiny ant carried a large crumb.
example.chinese: 一只小小的蚂蚁搬着一大块面包屑。

application.prompt: The seed is so ___ that it is hard to see. A. tiny B. lively
application.solution: A。解析：tiny 表示“极小的”。

grammar: adj. 精力充沛的；生机勃勃的；热闹的。可形容人、活动或地方。
collocations: a lively discussion; a lively child; a lively town
commonMistake: lively 是形容词，描述有活力、热闹；副词“生动地”常用 lively 的近义表达 vividly，不把 lively 当副词。

example.english: The children had a lively discussion about animals.
example.chinese: 孩子们热烈地讨论了动物。

application.prompt: The students were active and full of energy during the game. They were ___. A. tiny B. lively
application.solution: B。解析：lively 可形容人精力充沛、充满活力。
